# Get-ZbxAgentHost

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the host an agent session created on the server, and which of its items the session answers.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxAgentHost [-Session] <string> [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxAgentHost cmdlet reads, from the server, the host that Initialize-ZbxAgentHost created or reused for the agent session named in -Session, and writes it with one entry per item: the item's key, its id, and whether a handler of the session still answers it. An item without a local handler is one the session would report as not supported. It needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Check which items the agent answers

```powershell
(Get-ZbxAgentHost -Session 'web-agent').Items | Select-Object Key, HasLocalHandler
```

HasLocalHandler is false for an item no built-in key or registered handler answers.

### Example 2: Read the host as the server holds it

```powershell
(Get-ZbxAgentHost -Session 'web-agent').Host | Select-Object TechnicalName, HostId, Status
```

Host is the full ZabbixHost record.

## PARAMETERS

### -Session

The running agent session (Start-ZbxActiveAgent/Start-ZbxPassiveAgent's -Name) whose handler keys become items, and which remembers what was created on the server.
